create_ConcatIndices: create a ConcatIndices instance from a list of dataset sizes to map concatenated indices to (dataset_idx, sample_idx) pairs
test_ConcatIndices: test ConcatIndices index mapping for valid and out-of-range indices across multiple datasets
create_CSVLogger: create a CSVLogger instance with a filename and header row for buffered append-to CSV writing
create_MonitoredDataset: create a MonitoredDataset wrapping a PyTorch dataset with per-worker resource monitoring and periodic logging
test_MonitoredDataset: test MonitoredDataset delegates __getitem__ and __len__ to the wrapped dataset while starting resource monitoring
